name: Stinson v. United States
summary: The Supreme Court held that commentary in the Guidelines Manual that interprets or explains a guideline is authoritative unless it violates the Constitution or a federal statute, or is inconsistent with the guideline it purports to interpret.
significance: This is the central precedent at issue—the case that established the rule requiring courts to defer to Sentencing Guidelines commentary as if it were authoritative law unless plainly inconsistent with the guideline itself.
